title: Toward Agentic AI for the 6G Physical Layer: From Algorithm Discovery to Verified Baseband Silicon
title_zh: 面向6G物理层的智能体AI：从算法发现到经验证的基带硅片

paragraphs.en: 6G will be designed faster than it can be built: AI-driven search already proposes physical-layer algorithms at machine speed, while carrying a single one onto embedded baseband silicon remains specialist work. That silicon imposes hard memory and numeric limits, but also exposes cost structures a GPU lacks, and a design flow that never runs on the target sees neither. We present an agentic workflow in which an LLM coding agent implements algorithms on a commercial baseband SoC, optimizes them down to agent-written vector assembly, and validates them on silicon. The agent is guided by a knowledge base of measured platform facts, checked at every step against evaluators it is instructed never to edit, and metered per phase. We showcase the workflow on an AI-discovered orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) detector portfolio on the open 6G4All platform. It yields twelve kernels that run cycle-exactly on silicon, their optimized versions at 18 k–405 k cycles (30–660 𝝁 \boldsymbol{\mu} s) per frame. It also yields a new detector shaped by the chip’s measured costs that needs 13.9% fewer cycles than the port of the discovered detector while matching its error rate, with a measured edge our evaluation cannot statistically resolve, a structure that a hardware-blind search objective had no reason to find. What is not specific to OTFS is the workflow: an LLM agent exploring an implementation space under real hardware limits, with the cost of every choice measured rather than assumed.
paragraphs.zh: 6G 的设计速度将超过其构建速度：AI 驱动的搜索已经能以机器速度提出物理层算法，而把单个算法落地到嵌入式基带芯片上仍是专家级工作。 这种芯片带来严格的内存与数值限制，但也暴露了 GPU 所不具备的成本结构，而从未在目标硬件上运行过的设计流程两者都看不到。 我们提出一种智能体化工作流，其中 LLM 编程智能体在商用基带 SoC 上实现算法，将其优化到智能体编写的向量汇编层面，并在芯片上进行验证。 该智能体由一个包含实测平台事实的知识库引导，在每一步都受到其被指示永不修改的评估器检验，并按阶段计量。 我们在开放的 6G4All 平台上，用一组 AI 发现的正交时频空间（OTFS）检测器组合来展示该工作流。 它产出了十二个可在芯片上精确按周期运行的内核，其优化版本每帧耗时 18 k–405 k 周期（30–660 𝝁 \boldsymbol{\mu} s）。 它还产出了一个由芯片实测成本塑造的新型检测器，相比移植版发现检测器所需周期减少 13.9%，同时错误率相当，且具有我们的评估在统计上无法分辨的实测优势——这是一种只看性能、不感知硬件的搜索目标没有理由发现的结构。 不局限于 OTFS 的是该工作流本身：LLM 智能体在真实硬件限制下探索实现空间，每一个选择的成本都是实测而非假设的。

paragraphs.en: Whatever 6G turns out to be (new waveforms, integrated sensing, AI-native receivers), each of its features will in the end be a signal-processing algorithm that has to run inside the cycle, memory and power envelope of baseband silicon. How fast those features reach real radios will therefore be limited less by algorithm ideas than by the path from idea to silicon. Candidate algorithms already arrive faster than they can be deployed: large language model (LLM) -driven evolutionary search explores physical-layer solution spaces wholesale, and the framework of Aït Aoudia et al. [ 1 ] explored 1114 distinct orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) equalizer architectures and produced a detector that outperforms published baselines, in simulation and on graphics processing units (GPUs) . Carrying any one of those ideas onto an embedded baseband processor remains specialist work. Such parts earn their power efficiency by omitting what a general-purpose core provides: the digital signal processor (DSP) used here has no scalar floating-point unit at all, so scalar float arithmetic falls back on software emulation and costs orders of magnitude more than the same work on the vector array. Respecting that asymmetry is not an optimization detail; it decides whether an algorithm fits at all. Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) has reached the physical layer at the level of intent and configuration, in simulation [ 2 ] ; this paper turns it toward implementation on the silicon itself: we demonstrate, on the open 6G4All platform [ 3 ] , that an appropriately instrumented environment lets an LLM coding agent do that specialist work end to end (implement, optimize at assembly level, validate on silicon) at measured cost. If new algorithms can reach real baseband hardware this cheaply, the hardware stops being where 6G research ends and becomes part of the loop that proposes it.
paragraphs.zh: 无论6G最终是什么形态（新波形、通感一体化、AI原生接收机），它的每一项特性最终都是一个信号处理算法，必须在基带芯片的周期、内存和功耗限制内运行。 因此，这些特性到达真实无线电设备的速度，与其说受限于算法构想，不如说受限于从构想到芯片的路径。 候选算法的产生速度已经超过了它们的部署速度：由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的进化搜索整体性地探索物理层解空间，而Aït Aoudia等人的框架 [1] 探索了1114种不同的正交时频空间（OTFS）均衡器架构，并生成了一种在仿真和图形处理器（GPU）上都优于已发表基线的检测器。 但要把其中任何一个构想迁移到嵌入式基带处理器上，仍然是一项专门的工作。 这类芯片通过省去通用核心所提供的功能来换取能效：这里使用的数字信号处理器（DSP）完全没有标量浮点单元，因此标量浮点运算只能依靠软件模拟，其代价比在向量阵列上完成同样的工作高出几个数量级。 尊重这种不对称性并非一个可有可无的优化细节；它决定了算法究竟能否落地。 智能体式人工智能（AI）已经在意图与配置层面进入物理层（在仿真中）[2]；本文则将其转向芯片本身的实现：我们在开放的6G4All平台[3]上证明，一个经过适当配置的环境能够让一个LLM编码智能体以可衡量的成本端到端地完成那项专门工作（实现、在汇编级优化、在芯片上验证）。 如果新算法能以如此低的成本到达真实的基带硬件，那么硬件将不再是6G研究的终点，而成为提出这些算法的闭环的一部分。

At its published operating point the discovered detector’s serialized channel representation occupies some 63 MB against roughly 28 kB of usable target memory (Table I ); no word length closes three orders of magnitude, which is why this campaign runs at reduced grid dimensions, a consequence of the platform rather than a convenience, and a constraint the algorithm must be designed around rather than engineered away. And the platform’s advantages are equally invisible to a search whose evaluator prices only GPU latency: that objective [ 1 ] leaves memory and DSP arithmetic unpriced, so nothing rewards the structures this chip’s cost model does, which is where the campaign’s new detector comes from (Sec. IV-B ).

paragraphs.en: We report one campaign, run end to end with the OTFS portfolio as its demonstration workload. It makes three contributions. (i) An agentic workbench in which every claim the agent makes is falsifiable: measured platform knowledge, machine-checkable tooling, frozen evaluators and a per-phase effort meter (Sec. III ). (ii) An executed showcase: four classical baselines and a discovered detector re-derived clean-room, optimized in agent-written vector assembly and validated on silicon, plus a new detector designed under the platform’s measured cost model that lands on the campaign’s error-rate/cycle Pareto front (Secs. IV – V ). (iii) A per-phase accounting of engineering effort, metered from the agent’s own transcripts rather than self-reported (Sec. V-C ). A pre-registered, exploratory ablation probes the knowledge layer itself on two kernels (Sec. V-D ): there, documentation changed not what the agent could reach but how deep it went.

paragraphs.en: The campaign runs on 6G4All [ 3 ] : a LimeSDR-Micro board around the NXP LA9310, a commercial baseband system-on-chip (SoC) pairing a Cortex-M4 control core with a second-generation Vector Signal Processing Accelerator (VSPA) vector DSP (614.4 MHz, 16 arithmetic units, up to 16 complex single-precision operations per clock). The VSPA clock is exactly four times the part’s maximum converter rate of 153.6 MS/s, so streaming work has a budget of four cycles per sample at the maximum rate. The working memories are hard limits: 16 kB of data memory (DMEM) (12 160 B usable for static data), 32 kB program memory (PRAM) , and 16 kB of auxiliary Intervector Permutation Processing Unit (IPPU) data memory used as spill space. Firmware, drivers, kernel library and test infrastructure are open repositories.
paragraphs.zh: 该活动运行在 6G4All [ 3 ] 上：一块围绕 NXP LA9310 的 LimeSDR-Micro 开发板，LA9310 是一款商用基带片上系统（SoC），将 Cortex-M4 控制核与第二代向量信号处理加速器（VSPA）向量 DSP 相结合（614.4 MHz，16 个运算单元，每时钟周期最多 16 次复数单精度运算）。 VSPA 的时钟恰好是该部件最大转换速率 153.6 MS/s 的四倍，因此在最大速率下，流式处理工作每个样本只有四个时钟周期的预算。 工作存储器是硬性限制：16 kB 数据存储器（DMEM）（其中 12 160 B 可用于静态数据）、32 kB 程序存储器（PRAM），以及 16 kB 用作溢出空间的辅助向量间置换处理单元（IPPU）数据存储器。 固件、驱动程序、内核库和测试基础设施均为开放代码库。

paragraphs.en: The discovery framework of [ 1 ] , with its companion study [ 4 ] , couples an LLM that writes candidate algorithms with an evolutionary archive and a Sionna-based link-level evaluator [ 5 ] . Its OTFS repository ships one discovered artifact, an expectation consistency (EC) detector with Doppler block-diagonalization, Cholesky solves and a Richardson half-pass, plus four tuned classical baselines: linear minimum mean square error (LMMSE) , expectation propagation (EP) [ 6 ] , Gaussian message passing (MP) [ 7 ] , and unitary approximate message passing (UAMP) [ 8 ] ; notably none is a neural network: the search produced structure plus scalar constants, which is what an embedded target can afford. Its fitness is computed entirely in simulation, modeling neither the cost of transcendentals on a DSP without scalar floating-point arithmetic nor the candidate’s memory footprint (Table I ): no variant on the published Pareto front is buildable as published.
paragraphs.zh: [1]的发现框架及其配套研究[4]，将一个编写候选算法的大语言模型（LLM）与进化档案库以及基于Sionna的链路级评估器[5]相结合。 其OTFS代码库发布了一个被发现的产物——一个带有多普勒块对角化、Cholesky求解和Richardson半步的期望一致性（EC）检测器，外加四个经过调优的经典基线：线性最小均方误差（LMMSE）、期望传播（EP）[6]、高斯消息传递（MP）[7]以及酉近似消息传递（UAMP）[8]；值得注意的是，其中没有任何一个是神经网络：搜索产生的是结构加标量常数，而这正是嵌入式目标所能承受的。 其适应度完全在仿真中计算，既没有对无标量浮点运算的DSP上超越函数的计算代价建模，也没有对候选算法的内存占用建模（表I）：已发表的帕累托前沿上没有任何一个变体能够按原样构建。

paragraphs.en: Agentic implementation is an active line whose neighboring axes are occupied: agents write low-level code for general-purpose CPUs [ 17 ] , close loops against measured hardware on microcontrollers [ 18 ] and on GPUs with profiler feedback, reported cost and kernels no human wrote [ 19 , 20 ] , and carry wireless functions to programmable radios, taking MATLAB through high-level synthesis (HLS) to bitstream and board with resource and latency results [ 21 ] , or to verified over-the-air emission [ 22 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体化实现是一条活跃的研究路线，其相邻轴线上已有相关工作：智能体可为通用 CPU 编写底层代码 [ 17 ]，可在微控制器 [ 18 ] 上以及在 GPU 上结合性能分析器反馈、报告的成本与无人工编写的内核来闭合测量硬件的回路 [ 19 , 20 ]；智能体还可将无线功能带入可编程无线电，将 MATLAB 经高层综合（HLS）生成比特流并部署到板卡，给出资源与延迟结果 [ 21 ]，或实现经验证的空中发射 [ 22 ]。

paragraphs.en: The instruments make every step machine-checkable: the vendor toolchain compiles C and VSPA assembly against a fixed linker map whose overflow errors are themselves fitness signals; a cycle-accurate simulator returns pass/fail and a cycle count for any kernel; and a scripted debug bridge loads the kernel onto the core and reads the result back, a source-to-silicon verdict in seconds without a boot flow or probe.
paragraphs.zh: 这些工具使每一步都可由机器验证：厂商工具链根据固定的链接器映射图编译 C 与 VSPA 汇编代码，其溢出错误本身即是适应度信号；周期精确的模拟器会针对任意内核返回通过/失败结果及周期计数；脚本化的调试桥将内核加载到核心上并读回结果，在几秒内即可完成从源代码到芯片的判定，无需启动流程或探针。

paragraphs.en: The campaign template freezes what the agent must not touch: the discovery framework is pinned as a git submodule and the harness imports its channel model, low-density parity-check (LDPC) codec, quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) mapper and reference detectors call-for-call (Fig. 2 ); every candidate follows a fixed contract (faithful Python reference model, float32 C or assembly kernel, golden vectors derived from the model, self-checking tests) and is scored by one command whose first output line is machine-parseable, SUCCESS, <nve>, <cycles> .
paragraphs.zh: 活动模板冻结了智能体不可触碰的部分：发现框架被固定为 git 子模块，测试框架逐函数调用其信道模型、低密度奇偶校验（LDPC）编解码器、正交幅度调制（QAM）映射器和参考检测器（图 2）；每个候选方案都遵循固定契约（忠实于原实现的 Python 参考模型、float32 的 C 或汇编内核、由模型导出的黄金向量、自检测试），并由一条命令评分，该命令的首行输出为机器可解析的 SUCCESS, <nve>, <cycles> 格式。

paragraphs.en: The effort meter runs each phase as its own tracked subagent and reads tokens and tool events from transcripts; nothing is self-reported.
paragraphs.zh: 努力度量器（effort meter）将每个阶段作为各自被追踪的智能体来运行，并从转录记录中读取 token 和工具事件；没有任何内容是自我上报的。

paragraphs.en: Pipeline. Every algorithm passes three gated phases (Fig. 1 ): _poc produces a Python reference (cross-validated where an upstream one exists) and a correctness-first C kernel, _opt the ISA-optimized version, and -hwtest , the only phase that touches silicon, the validation. The ordering uses each instrument where it is strong. Cross-validation against the upstream implementation and golden vectors anchor semantics before any optimization exists. The headless simulator then carries the optimization loop, where most iterations happen, and scales with compute rather than benches: many candidates can be optimized in parallel against one board. Silicon appears once, at the end, because the simulator proves to be an exact cost oracle (Sec. V-A finds the difference to be zero on all twelve kernels), so hardware validation confirms rather than discovers. Clean-room rules complete the protocol: the agent’s only sources are the template, the pinned checkout and the platform documentation, so measured effort reflects derivation, not copying.
paragraphs.zh: 流水线。 每个算法都经过三个有门控的阶段（图 1）：_poc 生成 Python 参考实现（若上游存在则进行交叉验证）以及一个以正确性为先的 C 内核，_opt 生成 ISA 优化版本，而 -hwtest 是唯一接触硅片的阶段，负责验证。 这种顺序让每种工具都在其擅长之处发挥作用。 在任何优化存在之前，针对上游实现的交叉验证和黄金向量确立了语义基准。 无头模拟器随后承担优化循环——大部分迭代都发生在这里——并且其扩展依赖算力而非实验台：多个候选方案可以针对同一块开发板并行优化。 硅片只在最后出现一次，因为模拟器被证明是一个精确的成本预言机（第 V-A 节发现该差异在全部十二个内核上均为零），因此硬件验证是确认而非发现。 净室规则完成了这套协议：智能体的唯一信息来源是模板、固定版本的检出版本以及平台文档，因此所测得的工作量反映的是推导能力，而非照抄。

paragraphs.en: The human brief asked only for one new detector of the agent’s own, shaped by what it had learned about the platform, and gated it on the Pareto front; the frozen inverse, its stabilizers and the iteration count below are the agent’s choices, documented with their measured motivation in the kernel’s record. That record also lists the variants the agent measured and rejected on its design-time two-point protocol: plain frozen Richardson ( NVE 1.83), the frozen step without Jacobi smoothing (3.17) or with only the leading half (0.764), and four iterations instead of three (0.572 against 0.530). The campaign’s own profiles supplied that motivation: in the kernels that solve per-block systems the solves dominate, with eight Gauss-Jordan solves at 38% of ec2rich_opt ’s cycles, while the nonlinear projection costs a fraction of a solve round. ec_frozen exploits that imbalance. Like the discovered detector it splits the channel into N N independent blocks along Doppler, but it pays for each block’s regularized inverse once , up front. Every subsequent EC iteration reuses that stale, frozen inverse only as a preconditioner : instead of refactorizing the block system, whose diagonal changes every iteration as the site precisions evolve, it applies the frozen inverse and corrects the result with a single Richardson step, a handful of matrix-vector products. Naively this diverges once precisions grow (re-measured spectral radius up to 43); three measured stabilizers make it work: the system is symmetrically rescaled so the correction stays exact at both extremes of precision, each frozen apply is bracketed by Jacobi smoothing steps, and every correction starts from the previous iterate rather than from zero. Because a refinement costs 2.8 k cycles against 7.6 k for a factorized solve round, a third EC iteration becomes affordable. It closes with a linear-collapsed QPSK demapper and is gated by reaching the Pareto front of the campaign’s own ports. Algorithm 1 gives the procedure and its main hyperparameters.
paragraphs.zh: 人类任务书只要求智能体自己提出一个新的检测器，由其对平台所学到的内容塑造，并以帕累托前沿作为门控；冻结逆矩阵、其稳定化手段以及下文的迭代次数都是智能体的选择，并在内核记录中连同其测量依据一起记录在案。 该记录还列出了智能体在其设计期两点协议上测量并否决的变体：普通冻结 Richardson（NVE 1.83）、不带 Jacobi 平滑的冻结步（3.17）或只带前半段平滑的版本（0.764），以及用四次迭代代替三次（0.572 对 0.530）。 该战役自身的剖析数据提供了这一依据：在求解逐块系统的内核中，求解占主导地位，ec2rich_opt 的周期中有八次高斯-约当求解占 38%，而非线性投影只花费一次求解轮次的一小部分。ec_frozen 正是利用了这一不均衡。 与发现的检测器一样，它沿多普勒维将信道切分为 N×N 个独立块，但它对每个块的正则化逆矩阵只预先支付一次。 之后每一次 EC 迭代都只将该过时的、冻结的逆矩阵用作预条件子：它不重新分解那个对角线随位置精度演化而每次迭代都变化的块系统，而是应用冻结逆矩阵，并用单次 Richardson 步（即少量矩阵-向量乘积）对结果进行校正。 一旦精度增长，这样做会朴素地发散（重新测得的谱半径高达 43）；三种实测的稳定化手段使其可行：系统被对称地重缩放，使校正在精度的两个极端都保持精确；每次冻结矩阵的应用都被 Jacobi 平滑步夹在中间；并且每次校正都从上一次迭代的结果而非从零开始。 由于一次精化只需 2.8k 周期，而一次分解求解轮次要 7.6k 周期，第三次 EC 迭代便变得可以负担。 它以一个线性坍缩的 QPSK 解映射器收尾，并以达到该战役自身端口的帕累托前沿作为门控条件。 算法 1 给出了该流程及其主要超参数。

paragraphs.en: All twelve kernels were promoted to silicon in the separated hardware phase, over a self-hosted transport that needs no debug probe. Every kernel reproduced its simulator cycle count exactly , with zero difference, across four orders of magnitude of frame cost, soft-float C and agent-written assembly, 0–8704 B of IPPU data memory (in bytes, since simulator and chip expose different ceilings), and up to 100% DMEM occupancy; at 248 M cycles that is agreement to one part in 2.5 ⋅ 10 8 2.5\cdot 10^{8} . A smoke kernel shows a reproducible one-cycle offset, so the instrument resolves a single cycle and the twelve exact matches are not measurement insensitivity. The agreement is a property of the code, not of one trace: most detectors have data-dependent cycle counts ( mp_poc varies 2.8 × \times across seeds), ten-seed sweeps, each seed a fresh channel, noise and payload draw, exercise those paths on every kernel. A seed passes when simulator and silicon cycle counts are equal, the LLRs meet the golden tolerance (absolute 5 ⋅ 10 − 3 5\cdot 10^{-3} , relative 2 ⋅ 10 − 3 2\cdot 10^{-3} ), and every LLR the reference is confident about ( | LLR | > 1 |\mathrm{LLR}|>1 ) keeps its sign: agreement is exact in cycles, toleranced in values and exact in confident bit decisions. Across 120 seed runs: 113 pass, 6 are generator margin-guard rejections ( ep_opt seeds 101 and 108, both MP kernels’ seeds 102 and 109; re-running their host generators reproduces each rejection, so none is a masked dependency failure), and one fails, the uamp_opt seed discussed below. Two mechanisms by which silicon might still have diverged were falsified. The same workspace is placed roughly 500 kB apart in the simulator and chip address maps yet costs identical cycles, so placement does not affect timing; and kernels at 100% DMEM occupancy match as exactly as those at 69.5%, so the chip adds no memory wait states the simulator omits.
paragraphs.zh: 在分立的硬件阶段，全部十二个内核被推进到硅片实现，其自托管传输通道无需调试探针。 每个内核都精确复现了其模拟器周期数，零差异，覆盖四个数量级的帧开销、软件浮点 C 与智能体编写的汇编、0–8704 字节的 IPPU 数据存储器占用（以字节计，因为模拟器与芯片暴露的上限不同），以及最高 100% 的 DMEM 占用率；在 2.48 亿周期时，这相当于 1/2.5·10⁸ 的一致度。 一个冒烟内核显示出可复现的单周期偏移，因此该仪器能分辨单个周期，十二例完全匹配并非测量不敏感所致。 这种一致是代码本身的属性，而非某一条轨迹的属性：大多数检测器具有依赖数据的周期数（mp_poc 在不同种子间变化达 2.8 倍），十种子扫描（每个种子都是全新的信道、噪声与载荷抽取）在每个内核上都会遍历这些路径。 一个种子通过的条件是：模拟器与硅片的周期数相等，LLR 满足黄金容差（绝对 5·10⁻³，相对 2·10⁻³），且参考实现所确信（|LLR|>1）的每一个 LLR 都保持其符号：即周期上完全一致、数值上有容差、确信的比特判决完全一致。 在 120 次种子运行中：113 次通过，6 次为生成器裕度保护拒绝（ep_opt 的种子 101 与 108，两个 MP 内核的种子 102 与 109；重新运行它们的主机生成器可复现每一次拒绝，因此没有一次是被掩盖的依赖失败），1 次失败，即下文讨论的 uamp_opt 种子。 硅片仍可能产生分歧的两种机制已被证伪。 同一工作区在模拟器与芯片地址映射中相隔约 500 kB 放置，却产生完全相同的周期数，因此放置位置不影响时序；DMEM 占用率达 100% 的内核与占用率 69.5% 的内核匹配得同样精确，因此芯片并未增加模拟器所省略的存储器等待状态。

paragraphs.en: What the hardware phase caught was faults in the verification tooling , not the silicon, in two ways. First, the multi-seed sweep script silently classified missing Python dependencies as margin-guard skips and returned success; a table of skipped seeds was indistinguishable from a clean pass. Second, the frame generators’ float32 twin cannot see the assembly kernels’ special-function arithmetic: one uamp_opt seed misses the golden tolerance by 1.4 × \times , bit-identically on silicon and in the simulator and with no confident sign flipped, while the twin that screens seeds scores that frame at 0.1% of its budget. We keep and report the seed. The fixes are a sweep that tells a failed generator from a guard rejection, and a twin that emulates the special-function approximations, as several kernels’ reference models already do for their exponential, instead of exact float32. This is the sim-to-real lesson displaced one level: on a silicon-exact simulator the residual reality gap moves out of the hardware and into the verification models.
paragraphs.zh: 硬件阶段所捕获的是验证工具中的故障，而不是硅片本身的问题，体现在两个方面。 首先，多种子扫描脚本将缺失的 Python 依赖静默地归类为裕度保护跳过并返回成功；一张被跳过种子的表格与一次干净的通过无法区分。 其次，帧生成器的 float32 孪生模型无法看到汇编内核的特殊函数算术：一个 uamp_opt 种子以 1.4 × \times 的差距超出黄金容差，在硅片和仿真器中比特级完全一致，且没有任何置信符号翻转，而用于筛选种子的孪生模型却以 0.1% 的预算为该帧评分。 我们保留并报告该种子。 修复方案是一个能够区分生成器失败与保护拒绝的扫描，以及一个模拟特殊函数近似的孪生模型（正如多个内核的参考模型已经为其指数运算所做的那样），而不是精确的 float32。 这是被移了一级的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）教训：在一个硅片级精确的仿真器上，残余的现实差距从硬件中移出，进入了验证模型。

sents.en: Second, the frame generators’ float32 twin cannot see the assembly kernels’ special-function arithmetic: one uamp_opt seed misses the golden tolerance by 1.4 × \times , bit-identically on silicon and in the simulator and with no confident sign flipped, while the twin that screens seeds scores that frame at 0.1% of its budget.
sents.zh: 其次，帧生成器的 float32 孪生模型无法看到汇编内核的特殊函数算术：一个 uamp_opt 种子以 1.4 × \times 的差距超出黄金容差，在硅片和仿真器中比特级完全一致，且没有任何置信符号翻转，而用于筛选种子的孪生模型却以 0.1% 的预算为该帧评分。

sents.en: We keep and report the seed.
sents.zh: 我们保留并报告该种子。

sents.en: The fixes are a sweep that tells a failed generator from a guard rejection, and a twin that emulates the special-function approximations, as several kernels’ reference models already do for their exponential, instead of exact float32.
sents.zh: 修复方案是一个能够区分生成器失败与保护拒绝的扫描，以及一个模拟特殊函数近似的孪生模型（正如多个内核的参考模型已经为其指数运算所做的那样），而不是精确的 float32。

sents.en: This is the sim-to-real lesson displaced one level: on a silicon-exact simulator the residual reality gap moves out of the hardware and into the verification models.
sents.zh: 这是被移了一级的仿真到现实（sim-to-real）教训：在一个硅片级精确的仿真器上，残余的现实差距从硬件中移出，进入了验证模型。

paragraphs.en: That NVE margin, however, is not resolved by this protocol. The protocol is the framework’s own Monte-Carlo setting (batches of eight, 50 block errors or at most 1600 frames per point), kept unmodified and frozen before the campaign so that no agent could tune the gate it is scored by; it separates detectors that differ by tens of percent, as EP , UAMP and MP do from ec_frozen_opt (Fig. 3 ), but not the front’s members from each other. The evaluation stores rates, not counts. The stopping rule lets the counts be recovered uniquely, and the same procedure reproduces the reduction sweep’s recorded counts in all 50 cases. Treating the curtailed sampling as negative-binomial then gives approximate 95% intervals of ± \pm 0.14 and ± \pm 0.15, about threefold the separation. Over all six stored signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) points (2–12 dB) neither detector is consistently ahead (equal counts at 2 and 4 dB, ec_frozen_opt lower at 8 and 10 dB, ec2rich_opt at 6 and 12 dB), and every pair’s 95% Clopper–Pearson intervals overlap. The runs shared frames only up to 8 dB, since each stopping point shifts the random stream, so the records allow no paired comparison. The defensible claim is therefore its place on the front: strictly cheaper at an error rate this protocol cannot separate, that is, NVE parity rather than superiority. Settling the error-rate difference needs a paired re-evaluation that retains per-frame outcomes. Cycle counts carry no such caveat; they are deterministic and exact.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，该协议并未解决这一 NVE 裕度问题。 该协议是框架自带的蒙特卡洛设置（每批八个样本、每个数据点 50 个块错误或至多 1600 帧），在评测活动开始前保持原样并冻结，因此任何智能体都无法调优用于给自己评分的门槛；它能区分开相差数十个百分点的检测器，如 EP、UAMP 和 MP 与 ec_frozen_opt（图 3），但无法区分前沿内部的各个成员。 评测存储的是比率，而不是计数。 停止规则使这些计数能够被唯一地恢复，并且同一流程在全部 50 个案例中都复现了缩减扫描所记录的计数。 将截断的抽样视为负二项分布，则可得到约 ±0.14 和 ±0.15 的近似 95% 区间，约为上述差距的三倍。 在全部六个存储的信噪比（SNR）点（2–12 dB）上，两个检测器谁也不始终领先（2 和 4 dB 计数相等，8 和 10 dB 时 ec_frozen_opt 更低，6 和 12 dB 时 ec2rich_opt 更低），且每一对的 95% Clopper–Pearson 区间都相互重叠。 各次运行仅在最高 8 dB 时共享帧，因为每个停止点都会移动随机数流，因此这些记录无法进行配对比较。 因此，站得住脚的说法是它在前沿上的位置：以该协议无法区分的错误率而言成本严格更低，也就是说，是 NVE 上的持平而非优势。 要厘清这一错误率差异，需要进行保留逐帧结果的配对重新评测。 循环计数不存在此类问题；它们是确定性且精确的。

paragraphs.en: Deriving an algorithm is cheap and uniform; making it fast is not: across the five ports the proof-of-concept phases cost 219.5 k output tokens and the optimization phases 1604.5 k, a 7.3 × \times asymmetry, and proof-of-concept cost is flat (38.5–52.5 k) whether the algorithm is a one-shot linear solve ( LMMSE ) or a fifteen-iteration message-passing scheme ( MP ).
paragraphs.zh: 推导算法是廉价且统一的；让它变快则不然：在五个移植版本中，概念验证阶段的成本为 219.5 k 输出 token，而优化阶段的成本为 1604.5 k，存在 7.3 × \times 的不对称性；且无论算法是一次性线性求解（ LMMSE ）还是十五次迭代的消息传递方案（ MP ），概念验证的成本都是平坦的（38.5–52.5 k）。

paragraphs.en: Silicon is the cheapest phase: validating all twelve kernels cost 97.0 k tokens, 4% of the metered total, a consequence of the simulator being exact, inverting the assumption that hardware is the scarce tier.
paragraphs.zh: 硅是最便宜的阶段：验证全部十二个内核仅花费 97.0 k token，占计量总量的 4%，这是模拟器完全精确的结果，颠覆了硬件是稀缺层的假设。

paragraphs.en: Documented knowledge is reused across phases: the final optimization phase, re-run blind on a stripped repository, passed its golden test on the first simulator run and built no probe kernels, having inherited four candidates’ documented ISA facts (an audit traces 43 of 50 earlier facts into reuse).
paragraphs.zh: 已记录的知识在各阶段间被复用：最终优化阶段在剥离了内容的代码库上重新盲跑，首次模拟器运行即通过了黄金测试，且未构建任何探针内核——它继承了四个候选方案中已记录的 ISA 事实（审计显示 50 条早期事实中有 43 条被复用）。

paragraphs.en: The phases ran in sequence by design, so per-algorithm effort is a point on a learning trajectory, not an independent sample.
paragraphs.zh: 各阶段按设计顺序运行，因此每个算法的努力程度只是学习轨迹上的一个点，而非独立样本。

paragraphs.en: Repeating the LMMSE port clean-room reproduced the campaign closely (same NVE ; 18 111 against 18 318 cycles), suggesting its operating points are set by the protocol rather than by one run. That control makes a stronger experiment possible: whole phases re-run with the knowledge layer reduced or removed, pre-registered with token caps and outcome criteria fixed in advance and withheld from the workers, which saw only their task brief, on LMMSE , the portfolio’s simplest port and the only one whose campaign run started from the same knowledge state as the documented arm, and on EP , the port that leans hardest on hand-built approximations: it needs a vector exponential and a log-sum-exp the ISA does not provide, and runs at 100% DMEM . The two bracket the portfolio by design; each arm re-runs whole phases at 0.24–0.46 M output tokens, which is why the ablation covers these two rather than all six and runs each cell once.
paragraphs.zh: 重做 LMMSE 端口的洁净室复现高度还原了该实验活动（相同的 NVE；18 111 对 18 318 个周期），这表明其运行点由协议设定，而非由单次运行决定。 这一对照使得更强的实验成为可能：在知识层被削减或移除的情况下重跑整个阶段，预先注册、事先固定 token 上限与结果判据并对工作者保密（工作者只看到自己的任务简报）；实验对象为 LMMSE——组合中最简单的端口，也是唯一一个其活动运行与文档记录分支从相同知识状态出发的端口，以及 EP——最依赖手工构建近似的端口：它需要 ISA 未提供的向量指数运算和对数-求和-指数（log-sum-exp），并以 100% 的 DMEM 运行。 这两者在设计上即为组合的两端；每个分支各以 0.24–0.46 M 输出 token 重跑整个阶段，这就是消融实验仅覆盖这两个而非全部六个端口、且每个单元只运行一次的原因。

paragraphs.en: Why the search missed it. The cost model that makes ec_frozen attractive does not exist on a GPU , where factorization is not the bottleneck: the framework’s own Krylov/preconditioned family drew 130 candidates and scored second-worst of eleven [ 1 ] . We do not claim the search could not have found this detector; its objective gave it no gradient toward it. The remedy is analytical and cheap, a design rule check at search time (footprint against data memory, code against program memory, operations against a slot budget) which this campaign calibrates with the twelve kernels’ measured silicon cycles.

paragraphs.en: Limitations. The campaign’s results hold for one operating point: 8 × 4 8\times 4 (Table I ), QPSK , NVE at two SNR points; NVE is normalized to each protocol’s own EP baseline, so our values are not comparable with the framework’s published ones, and dominance at 64 × 64 64\times 64 is not established. Scaling is not demonstrated: the Doppler-block decomposition makes the N N blocks independent, so a frame can stream block by block through double-buffered direct memory access (DMA) , but at 64 × 64 64\times 64 one block’s Gram matrix alone (32 kB in single precision) exceeds DMEM , so tiling must also reach inside the block, or the workload must move to a larger member of the family; no kernel has run in a live stack; and one optimized kernel misses the golden tolerance on one seed in ten, identically in simulator and silicon and with no bit decision changed (Sec. V-A ). The ablation covers two of six algorithms with one run per cell (Sec. V-D ), its arms still saw the vendor SDK’s example assembly, and ablating the full campaign remains open. Silicon validation covers correctness, memory fit and cycles; power, energy per frame and the DMA cost of moving a frame in and out were not measured. No non-agentic flow (compiler with hand-written intrinsics, autotuning, or an engineer under the same budget) was run as a baseline; the nearest point is the ablation’s documentation-free arms, which stayed largely in C with the SDK’s intrinsics, 1.8–2.2 × \times slower than assembly (Sec. V-D ). The campaign therefore establishes feasibility at a measured agent cost, not a productivity gain over such flows.
paragraphs.zh: 局限性。 该实验的结果仅适用于一个运行点：8 × 4 8\times 4（表 I）、QPSK、两个信噪比点上的 NVE；NVE 归一化到每个协议自身的 EP 基线，因此我们的数值与该框架已发表的数值不可比，且未在 64 × 64 64\times 64 上确立优势。 可扩展性未得到验证：多普勒分块分解使 N N 个块相互独立，因此一帧可以通过双缓冲直接内存访问（DMA）逐块流式处理，但在 64 × 64 64\times 64 下，单个块的 Gram 矩阵（单精度下 32 kB）就超出了 DMEM，因此分块策略必须进一步深入块内部，或者该工作负载必须转移到该系列中更大的成员上；没有任何内核在真实运行栈中运行过；并且其中一个优化内核在十分之一的随机种子上未达到黄金容差，在仿真器与实际芯片上的表现完全一致，且没有任何比特判决发生变化（第 V-A 节）。 消融实验仅覆盖六个算法中的两个，每个单元格只运行一次（第 V-D 节），其实验分支仍然接触过厂商 SDK 的示例汇编代码，对完整实验的消融仍有待完成。 芯片验证覆盖了正确性、内存适配和周期数；功耗、每帧能耗以及移入移出一帧的 DMA 开销未作测量。 没有运行任何非智能体流程（带手写内联函数的编译器、自动调优、或同等预算下的工程师）作为基线；最接近的参照点是消融实验中不含文档的分支，它们主要停留在使用 SDK 内联函数的 C 代码上，比汇编慢 1.8–2.2 × \times 倍（第 V-D 节）。 因此，该实验以可测量的智能体成本确立了可行性，而非相对于此类流程的生产力提升。

paragraphs.en: This work showed, for one detector portfolio on one commercial baseband SoC , that the step from a discovered algorithm to optimized silicon can be automated. Inside an instrumented workbench of measured platform knowledge, machine-checkable tooling and evaluators frozen by protocol, an LLM agent carried a discovered OTFS portfolio to verified, ISA -optimized kernels, with no vector assembly written by hand.
paragraphs.zh: 这项工作表明，对于一个商用基带 SoC 上的一个检测器组合而言，从已发现的算法到优化后的芯片这一步是可以自动化的。 在一个由实测平台知识、可机器检查的工具以及由协议冻结的评估器构成的受测工作台内，一个 LLM 智能体将一个已发现的 OTFS 组合推进到经过验证的、ISA 优化的内核，全程没有手工编写任何向量汇编。

paragraphs.en: The result holds where it can be checked. All twelve kernels reproduce their simulator cycle counts exactly on silicon; the optimized versions run at 18 k–405 k cycles (30–660 μ \mu s) per frame, and the two kernels on the resulting error-rate/cycle front spend 11% and 21% of the 267 μ \mu s frame. A detector designed under the platform’s measured cost model, reusing one frozen inverse instead of refactorizing, needs 13.9% fewer cycles than the discovered detector’s port while matching its error rate, with a measured edge the protocol cannot statistically resolve, a structure the source search objective did not reward. The campaign also measures how that effort was distributed: of 2.25 M metered agent tokens, 14% went to proof of concept, 82% to assembly optimization and 4% to hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 该结果在可检验之处均成立。 全部十二个核函数在硅片上精确复现其模拟器周期数；优化后的版本每帧运行 18 k–405 k 周期（30–660 μ\mu s），而处于最终错误率/周期前沿的两个核函数分别花费 267 μ\mu s 帧的 11% 和 21%。 在该平台的实测成本模型下设计的检测器，通过复用一个冻结的逆矩阵而非重新分解，其所需周期比所发现的检测器的移植版本少 13.9%，同时匹配其错误率，且实测差距在统计上无法被该协议分辨——这是一种源搜索目标未曾奖励的结构。 该实验活动还测量了这些工作量的分布：在 2.25 M 计量的智能体 token 中，14% 用于概念验证，82% 用于汇编优化，4% 用于硬件。

paragraphs.en: Nothing in the workflow is specific to OTFS , although only OTFS detection has been tested: what the campaign demonstrates is a way of working, with measured platform cost inside the loop that writes the code and every claim checked against something the agent is not permitted to edit. Larger members of the vendor’s baseband line (up to eight VSPA cores) admit the grids where iterative detectors earn their cost back. A discovery run under a hardware-aware objective is the experiment this work sets up.
